# bcr32

> Unofficial documentation and tools for the Behringer BCR32 MIDI controller and 4-track, 32-step sequencer. Not affiliated with Behringer or Music Tribe.

Control IDs used across the docs: B<n> = button, E<n> = encoder, SEL = select encoder, J<n> = rear jack. Step k = encoder E(24+k).

## Reference

- [BCR32 structured reference](docs/reference/bcr32-reference.md): every control, mode, menu, value range and procedure, plus known errors in the official manual

## Guides

- [Connect to Ableton Live](docs/guides/connect-to-ableton-live.md): USB-MIDI setup, track routing, clock master choice (unverified)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/guides/troubleshooting.md): symptoms and fixes (unverified)

## Project

- [Playbook and live status](docs/project/playbook.md): the task list with the current step and what remains
- [Project plan](docs/project/plan.md): phases for the manual, the BCR2000 and Zaquencer guide and the web panel (draft, awaiting approval)
- [Architecture note](docs/project/architecture.md): device data model, packages, view state, label overlay, MIDI seams (design, not built)
- [Decision log](docs/project/decisions.md): decisions with reasons
- [Unit safety protocol](docs/project/unit-safety.md): backup-first rules and risk tiers for tests on a real unit
- [Parking file](docs/project/parking.md): ideas not yet planned
- [README](README.md): overview and status
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): privacy rules and documentation standard
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
